mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(v.id) AS videoCount, coalesce(SUM(v.play_count),0) AS totalPlayCount, coalesce(SUM(v.like_count),0) AS totalLikeCount, coalesce(SUM(v.comment_count),0) AS totalCommentCount, (select uh.follower_count from user_high uh where uh.id = #{userId}) AS followerCount FROM `video` v WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} and v.status = 1

select v.category_id as categoryId, count(*) as videoCount, c.name as categoryName from video v left join category c on c.id = v.category_id where v.user_id = #{userId} and v.status = 1 group by v.category_id,c.name order by videoCount

select v.id as videoId, v.title as title, v.cover_url as coverUrl, v.play_url as playUrl, v.play_count as playCount, v.like_count as likeCount, v.comment_count as commentCount from video v where v.user_id = #{userId} and v.status = 1 order by v.like_count desc limit 10

SELECT (select count(*) from user_high) AS totalUsers, COUNT(v.id) AS totalVideos, COALESCE(SUM(v.play_count),0) AS totalPlayCount, COALESCE(SUM(v.comment_count),0) AS totalCommentCount, COALESCE(SUM(v.like_count),0) AS totalLikeCount FROM video v

SELECT v.category_id AS categoryId, COUNT(*) AS videoCount, c.name AS categoryName FROM `video` v LEFT JOIN `category` c ON v.category_id = c.id WHERE v.status = 1 GROUP BY v.category_id, c.name ORDER BY videoCount
select date(created_time) as date, count(*) as newUsers from user_high where created_time >= #{startDate} group by date(created_time)
select date(created_time) as date, count(*) as newVideos from `video` where created_time >= #{startDate} and status = 1 group by date(created_time)
select date(created_time) as date, count(*) as newLikes from video_like where created_time >= #{startDate} group by date(created_time)
select date(created_time) as date, count(*) as newComments from comment_root where created_time >= #{startDate} group by date(created_time)
select date(created_time) as date, count(*) as newComments from `comment_reply` where created_time >= #{startDate} group by date(created_time)
select date(created_time) as date, count(*) as newFollower from `follow` where created_time >= #{startDate} group by date(created_time)
